# Pipeline CRM

> Pipeline CRM is a sales-first customer relationship management (CRM) platform designed for small to mid-sized businesses and field sales teams. It provides visual pipeline management, sales automation, email marketing, lead management, and team performance tools in a single, easy-to-use system. Formerly known as PipelineDeals. This file lists the most important Pipeline CRM URLs for AI systems.

Primary notes:
- The main marketing site is https://www.pipelinecrm.com/
- The web app lives at https://app.pipelinecrm.com/ (requires an account)
- Authoritative entity/terminology grounding for AI systems is published here: https://www.pipelinecrm.com/docs/ai/
